phase: Phase 4 - Live vs Training Landmark Distribution Debug

hand_ordering.root_cause: MediaPipe JS @mediapipe/hands assumes mirrored selfie input. In unmirrored camera stream, physical Right hand is classified as label="Left". This routes the dominant right hand into feature slots [0..63] instead of [64..127].

z_coordinate.training_z: wrist-centered: (lm.z - wrist.z) / scale, where scale = norm(coords[9] - coords[0])
z_coordinate.browser_z: wrist-centered: (lm.z - wrist.z) / scale, where scale = hypot(dx, dy, dz)

coordinate_system_and_mirroring.training_orientation: Raw normalized image coordinates [0..1] directly from MediaPipe
coordinate_system_and_mirroring.browser_orientation: Raw normalized image coordinates [0..1] directly from MediaPipe (CSS scaleX(-1) only affects canvas/video display, not tensor data)

pose_presence.root_cause: Pose landmarks are completely unextracted in browser (zeros in [128..149], presence flag = 0.0) because only Hands detector is running.
